The holders are re-born downstream of the resource roll; see A′'S FULL DECLARATION, AS REFILLED (the fourth seat, COHERENCE-AGREE-4, 2026-11-12; the chair's rulings: declare every family; THE SLOT IS REFILLED, 1dde265d8). Measured at the lane's tip against the same tree with the access refusal disabled (a scratch counterfactual, never committed), over L2 2,866 + golden 525. THE MECHANISM: steps/resolveResources.js rolls exactly as before (the shuffle, the per-category picks, the fill, one depletion draw per slot); a winner whose required access is not the town's (the crossroads position off a crossroads) gives its slot to another admissible member by a hash of the step's seed and the refused key (its own category first, else any compatible member; not held, access met, not rare), keeping the slot's depletion draw; no draw is added. From steps/assembleInstitutions.js on (the first step that reads the rolled list: each institution's chance is multiplied by its nearby resources) a holder's later steps read a different list, its roster can re-roll, and every later draw on the birth's stream follows: the holder is RE-DEALT from that step on, which is why each family moves both ways. CONFINED: 540 births move = the 538 L2 holders + the 2 golden holders; 0 leaves move in the 2,851 non-holders (and 0 against da4f6a87b, the tip before the refill, for non-holders).
